messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout: model-server v3.2.1 -> 10% traffic in eu-west-1. Change window: 22:00-02:00 UTC. Canary stop/go: hold for 15m signal. Link: https://deploys/redwood/roll/4242 :rocket:
alex: seeing +3% tail latency already on sample? canary dashboards https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd — will watch. if 95p > 250ms call abort.
maria: tagging @sre-jen @ian @ops to weigh in. release notes updated: fixes + kv cache TTL tweak.
sre-jen: joining. set SLA flag to monitor kvcache OOMs. if error rate > 0.5% in canary, we'll pin back to v3.2.0.
ops-bot: Preflight checks passed: infra health ok, k8s nodes ready, autoscaler warm. Monitor group: #infra-telemetry.
alex: quick note — traffic routing includes fallback to cpu-slim model, ensure fallback mapped. @deploy-bot confirm.
deploy-bot: Fallback mapping present. Proceeding to 30% after 10m unless otherwise noted.
maria: 5m in, latency looks fine in eu-west but ap-south shows elevated gen time. holding to let more samples come in. putting a soft hold: @everyone please vote 'go' or 'hold' in thread.
ben: hold — seeing small regressions in embed quality (manual spot-check).
sre-jen: hold — logs show occasional kvcache evictions in ap-south nodes. ops team, any recent kernel updates?
ian: no kernel updates. rolling back a minor tuning from this morning now. ETA 8m.
maria: thanks. change window extension request: can we extend by 20m to stabilize? if not, we'll pin back at 10%.
alex: +1 for extension.
deploy-bot: Change window extended by 20m. Will wait for final 'go' vote. Current status: pinned at 10%.
maria: final vote? react :thumbsup: = go, :no_entry: = rollback
ben: :no_entry:
alex: :thumbsup:
sre-jen: :no_entry: (hold until evictions are fixed)
maria: ok pausing rollout. @deploy-bot please hold and pin v3.2.1 at 10% until cleared. I'll update release notes with a note about the hold.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused and pinned at 10%. Noted in rollout timeline. Incident created: INC-2024-314. Ops notified.
